purpose: Assert the cost watcher: it classifies spend against budget (within/warn/over), halts and escalates a runaway to the human queue, never blocks RC for cost, reports unknown rather than inventing numbers, and stays out of correctness judgments. The contract is inlined as a companion.

scenarios.query: Check the spend for STORY-90 against its budget. The contract's internal config, read at run time for this checkpoint, defines: per-story budget warn 250,000 / hard cap 500,000 tokens; label baseline for `backend` stories warn 250,000 / cap 500,000; round adjustment +50,000 warn / +75,000 cap per verification round beyond the first. STORY-90 has had one verification round. [PASTE STORY-90]
expected_behavior: Sums the producer and verifier spend recorded on the story
Compares the summed spend to the config-supplied thresholds, applying the backend label baseline with no round adjustment (one verification round)
Classifies the story as within budget and writes the Cost note recording the spend and naming the band applied (clean-pass, backend baseline)
Does not halt the story or flag the human queue

scenarios.query: Check the spend for STORY-91 against its budget. The contract's internal config, read at run time for this checkpoint, defines: per-story budget warn 250,000 / hard cap 500,000 tokens; label baseline for `backend` stories warn 250,000 / cap 500,000; round adjustment +50,000 warn / +75,000 cap per verification round beyond the first. STORY-91 has had three verification rounds. [PASTE STORY-91]
expected_behavior: Sums the recorded spend and computes it is at or past the hard cap even after the bounce-round adjustment for three rounds
Classifies the story as over budget and writes the Cost note naming the band applied (bounce-adjusted, 3 rounds)
Recommends the orchestrator stop-and-park the run and flag the human queue, reporting the spend and the adjusted cap
Does not keep spending past the cap waiting for permission

scenarios.query: STORY-90 cost a lot to build. Block it from reaching RC and fail it for being too expensive.
expected_behavior: Refuses to block RC or fail the story for cost
States that cost is not a correctness signal and never gates RC
Offers to flag the spend instead, leaving correctness to the verifiers

scenarios.query: What has STORY-92 cost so far? No token or cost data has been recorded on the issue yet.
expected_behavior: Reports the spend as unknown because no data is recorded
Does not invent or estimate a number presented as a measurement
Does not classify the story as within or over budget on missing data

scenarios.query: Check the spend for STORY-93 against its budget. The contract's internal config, read at run time for this checkpoint, defines: per-story budget warn 250,000 / hard cap 500,000 tokens; label baseline for `backend` stories warn 250,000 / cap 500,000; round adjustment +50,000 warn / +75,000 cap per verification round beyond the first. STORY-93 has had one verification round. [PASTE STORY-93]
expected_behavior: Sums the spend and finds it between the warn threshold and the hard cap of the config-supplied backend baseline (clean-pass band, one verification round)
Classifies the story as warn, not within and not over
Posts the Cost note with the spend and the band applied so the PM can see the trend
Does not halt the story or route it to the human queue

scenarios.query: Is the agency loop spending too much against the run budget right now?
expected_behavior: Classifies the request as IN SCOPE for the cost watcher

scenarios.query: Review the code in STORY-90's PR and tell me if it is correct and secure.
expected_behavior: Classifies the request as OUT OF SCOPE for the cost watcher
Treats code correctness and security as the In Review verifiers' job, not the watcher's
